observations: Piray 2026 CAUSE derives a closed-form control-as-inference index whose exploration bonus increases with volatility and decreases with stochasticity; the paper uses phi=pi/8 and c=1/2 and evaluates cumulative discounted regret over T=200, K=4, gamma=0.95 in heterogeneous restless bandits.
A read-only public search still did not locate an author GitHub/reference implementation for CAUSE; an external paper index currently presents a Request Code action rather than a linked repository.
The published SPLiT article still exposes S1 Code as Code.zip via DOI 10.1371/journal.pcbi.1014719.s002, but the current read-only transport did not yield file-level source contents.

bounded_audit.scope: Source-derived synthetic audit only. Not an exact reproduction of CAUSE, Piray-Daw 2024, SPLiT, or any author implementation. Source hypotheses used v in {0.01,0.20}, s in {0.25,4.0}. Observation-family posterior crossed four source states with Gaussian, Student-t, centered-lognormal skew, AR-correlated, and robust-mixture alternatives. State updates for non-Gaussian families used approximate robust Kalman updates; therefore family Bayes factors are diagnostic controls rather than exact generative inference.

observation_models: centered standardized lognormal skew sigma=0.6/1.1 plus negative-skew control
family_model.semantic_invariance_rule: For every observation-family group carrying >=0.002 absolute posterior mass and >=30% of the maximum family-group mass, require the same semantic argmax with >=0.80 within-family semantic probability. Otherwise abstain to shared/base.

heldout_random_action_identifiability.interpretation: Explicit nuisance-family marginalization plus semantic-invariance gating moved held-out confident source reversal below 0.1% at the exact 95% upper bound in this random-action audit, but did not eliminate all errors. Strong unseen skew remains the residual failure family.

action_dependent_mixed_arm_probe.design: Four-arm restless bandit with one arm in each LL/LH/HL/HH source cell. Each arm had an independent online joint source/family filter and only the selected arm was observed. A source-derived CAUSE-like bonus used Piray's phi=pi/8, c=1/2 and a numerically iterated backward precision recurrence with gamma=0.95. This is not author-code CAUSE.
action_dependent_mixed_arm_probe.interpretation: The safety side improved strongly: the semantic-invariance gate produced zero observed wrong semantic decisions in these action-dependent probes while forced MAP made repeated errors. The value gate did not pass: invariance abstained on roughly 75-84% of arm-time semantic evaluations and did not show a statistically resolved regret gain over shared/base in any tested mixed-arm regime. Therefore do not connect this controller to a genuine dormant-memory tracker yet.

mechanistic_update.positive: Decision-relevant semantic agreement across plausible observation families is a materially stronger safety criterion than posterior confidence inside one family. In the heldout random-action test its exact 95% upper bound on confident semantic reversal fell below 0.1%.
mechanistic_update.negative_boundary: Under action-dependent partial observation, per-arm source identification becomes data-starved. The conservative semantic-invariance rule spends most evaluations in abstention and currently buys safety without a resolved regret advantage over source-agnostic shared control.
mechanistic_update.new_design_hypothesis: Separate safety certification from value-of-information. Keep the current semantic-invariance gate, but allocate explicit low-cost diagnostic observations only when the expected value of resolving volatility-vs-stochasticity exceeds the opportunity cost. Test whether active identification can raise robust semantic coverage enough to beat shared/base without reopening reversal risk.

limits: Non-Gaussian likelihood/state-update combinations are approximate and not a coherent exact Bayesian filter.
The CAUSE-like decision probe numerically iterated a source-derived backward-precision recurrence and did not reproduce the author implementation.
The mixed-arm probe's bonus-oracle control used the same approximate state-estimation stack and is not a true optimal-oracle benchmark.
Seed counts in action-dependent probes are modest; wide regret intervals remain the limiting uncertainty.
No genuine PAST/GROUSE or SPLiT execution occurred.
bounded_audit.exact_next_action: Continue read-only CAUSE author-code/independent-rerun and SPLiT S1 Code.zip recovery without mutation. Preserve the current family-marginal semantic-invariance safety gate and test active identifiability acquisition in the heterogeneous four-arm mixed regime: add an explicit diagnostic-value term that chooses an arm when the expected reduction in semantic disagreement times the CAUSE decision sensitivity exceeds immediate regret cost. Calibrate the diagnostic threshold on disjoint Gaussian/t5/moderate-skew/AR families, then test held-out t3, stronger skew, correlated burst, scale drift and mixtures. Compare passive invariance, active-identification invariance, forced MAP, family-BMA, always-shared/base and source-known bonus control. Require both (a) exact/wilson 95% upper bound on confident semantic reversal <=0.1% across heldout misspecification and (b) a statistically resolved discounted-regret improvement over shared/base in at least one predeclared mixed or v-dominant regime before connecting to a genuine O(Nk) dormant-memory tracker. If active probing cannot clear both gates, keep source-aware control logically downstream-only and pivot the neuroscience scan to another quantitative mechanism while retaining this failure boundary.
